name: keel-mcp

tools.name: keel_overview
tools.description: Start here. Returns Keel's version, conventions, folder layout, the full list of doc topics, and the available code generators. Call this first when working in a Keel app.

tools.name: keel_search_docs
tools.description: Full-text search across all Keel guides. Returns the best-matching guides with a snippet and slug; follow up with keel_read_doc to read one in full.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. 'rate limit middleware' or 'belongsToMany'

tools.name: keel_read_doc
tools.description: Return a full Keel guide by slug (e.g. 'routing', 'models', 'queues'). Optionally append its runnable, type-checked example. Use keel_search_docs or keel_overview to find slugs.

include_example.description: Append the guide's example source if it has one (default false)

tools.name: keel_search_api
tools.description: Search the public export surface of `@shaferllc/keel/core` (382+ symbols). Returns matching value/type exports, the source module each lives in, and the guide that documents it.

tools.name: keel_list_generators
tools.description: List the `keel make:*` code generators, what each produces, and their flags. Use keel_scaffold to generate one.

tools.name: keel_scaffold
tools.description: Generate the stub for a Keel construct (controller, model, migration, provider, middleware, factory, seeder, job, notification, transformer) and return the code plus its target path. Does NOT write to disk — write the returned code yourself. Mirrors `keel make:*`. For migrations, replace the NNNN filename prefix with the next number in database/migrations/.

name.description: Base name, e.g. 'User', 'SendWelcome' — suffixes are normalized

resource.description: controller only: scaffold all seven RESTful actions

model.description: transformer only: the model it maps, e.g. 'User'

stderr: ⚓ Keel MCP server running on stdio
